description: This file contains GUI classes and functions for a Python application using GTK, including exception handling, message windows, and interface classes.

classes.name: GraphicalIntf
classes.description: GUI interface class inheriting from AbstractIntf, providing methods for network enabling, window management, and exception handling.

classes.name: SaveExceptionWindow
classes.description: Class for handling save exception windows, inheriting from AbstractSaveExceptionWindow.

classes.name: MainExceptionWindow
classes.description: Class for displaying main exception windows with traceback details, inheriting from AbstractMainExceptionWindow.

classes.name: MessageWindow
classes.description: Class for displaying message dialogs, inheriting from AbstractMessageWindow.

classes.name: ExitWindow
classes.description: Subclass of MessageWindow for exit confirmation dialogs.

methods.name: find_glade_file
methods.description: Function to locate a Glade UI file in specified directories.

methods.name: enableNetwork
methods.description: Method stub to enable network, meant to be overridden.

methods.name: exitWindow
methods.description: Displays an exit window with a message.

methods.name: mainExceptionWindow
methods.description: Creates and returns a main exception window with traceback info.
